title: Quarto project configuration
description: The site's _quarto.yml. It lists the keys an edit usually touches; add the keys your site uses, each with a description.

abstract.description: A short summary of the site, shown on pages that do not set their own.

author.description: The site's author or authors: a name, an object of details, or a list of either.

bibliography.description: The citation database file or files, such as references.bib.

book.description: Book settings: chapters, parts, and cover, when the project type is book.

categories.description: The categories pages can name, for listing pages on the site.

citation.description: How the site cites its own pages, as an object of citation details.

date.description: The site's date, shown on pages that do not set their own.

description.description: One sentence about the site, for search results and link previews.

doi.description: The site's DOI, shown on pages that do not set their own.

editor.description: The site's editor or editors, for books and collections.

execute.description: Default execution settings for code blocks: echo, warning, freeze, and their like.

filters.description: The Pandoc and Lua filters every page runs; the Slipway extension adds slipway here.

format.description: The output format or formats the project renders.

jupyter.description: Jupyter settings, such as the kernel to run Python code with.

keywords.description: Keywords for search engines and related pages.

lang.description: The site's language as a tag such as en or fa-IR.

license.description: The license the site's content is published under.

metadata.description: Document metadata shared by every page, such as author or date.

project.description: Project settings: the type, the files to render, and the output folder.

execute-dir.description: The folder code runs from, when not the folder of each page.

lib-dir.description: The folder Quarto copies libraries into.

output-dir.description: The folder the built site goes in; the Slipway starter uses _site.

output-file.description: The name of the built file, for a project with a single output.

post-render.description: The command or commands to run after each render; Slipway's post-render script goes here.

pre-render.description: The command or commands to run before each render.

render.description: The files and folders to render; other files are left out of the site.

resources.description: Files to copy into the output folder unchanged.

type.description: The kind of project: website, book, or a plain default project.

subtitle.description: A second line under the site title.

title.description: The site title, when pages do not set their own.

website.description: Website settings: the title, navigation, search, and footer.

bread-crumbs.description: true shows the path to the page above its title.

description.description: One sentence about the site, for search results and link previews.

favicon.description: The small icon shown in the browser tab.

navbar.description: The bar at the top: its title, logo, links, and tools.

repo-actions.description: The links to the page's source or history shown beside it.

repo-url.description: The address of the site's repository.

search.description: true adds a search box; an object sets its options.

sidebar.description: The sidebar: its title, contents, and position.

site-url.description: The address the site is served at, ending in /.

title.description: The site title, shown in the navbar and the browser tab.

toc.description: true shows a table of contents beside each page.
